versions.subject: Merge PR #5514 from @ajpc500 - Add Filefix TypedPaths Registry rule
versions.detection:
selection_base:
    TargetObject|endswith: '\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\TypedPaths\url1'
    Details|contains: '#'
    Image|endswith:
        - '\brave.exe'
        - '\chrome.exe'
        - '\firefox.exe'
        - '\msedge.exe'
selection_cmd:
    Details|contains:
        - 'cmd'
        - 'curl'
        - 'powershell'
        - 'bitsadmin'
        - 'certutil'
        - 'mshta'
        - 'regsvr32'
condition: all of selection_*

versions.subject: Merge PR #5763 from @swachchhanda000 - Update ClickFix/FileFix related rules
versions.detection:
selection_base:
    TargetObject|endswith: '\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\TypedPaths\url1'
    Details|contains|all:
        - '#'
        - 'http'
selection_cmd:
    - Details|contains:
          # Add more suspicious keywords
          - 'account'
          - 'anti-bot'
          - 'botcheck'
          - 'captcha'
          - 'challenge'
          - 'confirmation'
          - 'fraud'
          - 'human'
          - 'identification'
          - 'identificator'
          - 'identity'
          - 'robot'
          - 'validation'
          - 'verification'
          - 'verify'
    - Details|contains:
          - '%comspec%'
          - 'bitsadmin'
          - 'certutil'
          - 'cmd'
          - 'cscript'
          - 'curl'
          - 'finger'
          - 'mshta'
          - 'powershell'
          - 'pwsh'
          - 'regsvr32'
          - 'rundll32'
          - 'schtasks'
          - 'wget'
          - 'wscript'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: TargetObject="*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Explorer\\TypedPaths\\url1" Details="*#*" Details="*http*" Details IN ("*account*", "*anti-bot*", "*botcheck*", "*captcha*", "*challenge*", "*confirmation*", "*fraud*", "*human*", "*identification*", "*identificator*", "*identity*", "*robot*", "*validation*", "*verification*", "*verify*") OR Details IN ("*%comspec%*", "*bitsadmin*", "*certutil*", "*cmd*", "*cscript*", "*curl*", "*finger*", "*mshta*", "*powershell*", "*pwsh*", "*regsvr32*", "*rundll32*", "*schtasks*", "*wget*", "*wscript*")
